title: Move envelope
description: One client action on the socket update event. On the wire these are four positional arguments (action, stateID, matchID, playerID); the catalog frames them as one document.

type.description: Redux action type. MAKE_MOVE for the six actions and the lobby moves; GAME_EVENT for phase and turn events. UNDO and REDO are refused by the master for any match with more than one player.
Move or event name, e.g. build, network, sell, confirmTurn, sitDown, hostStart.

args.description: Positional arguments of that move handler. The optional last argument of build/network/develop/sell is a move-choices object.

credentials.description: That seat's secret, sent in full on every move. The master compares it against the stored value before applying anything.

state-id.description: The client's view of the authoritative state version. The master refuses the action outright when it differs from its own, which is what makes optimistic local application safe.

match-id.description: Match the action targets. Also the socket.io room the resulting broadcast fans out to.

player-id.description: Seat sending the action, repeated outside the payload because the transport routes on it before the master parses the action.
